# ── MUSIC: one track per world ────────────────────────────────────────────
# First line is the destination directory. Every line after is one asset:
#     slot<space>URL<space>licence text to end of line
#
# Paste a DIRECT FILE URL (ends .mp3 / .m4a / .ogg), not a page URL. Pushing
# this file on any branch except main runs .github/workflows/fetch-assets.yml,
# which downloads each one, transcodes m4a -> mp3, names it for its slot and
# writes CREDITS.txt beside it. A 404 fails the job rather than passing quietly.
#
# LICENCE RULE, and it is not negotiable for a children's App Store title:
# CC0, Public Domain, Pixabay Licence or Kenney only. No CC-BY-SA, no
# "free for non-commercial", no YouTube Audio Library rips. The licence text
# you put on the line is the record that answers a rights query later.
#
# WHAT EACH SLOT NEEDS TO SOUND LIKE (from public/assets/music/README.md):
#   maple    sleepy American small town, autumn, county fair. Warm, unhurried,
#            a bit brass-band.
#   pirate   five-star tropical resort cosplaying as a pirate hideout. Steel
#            drums, ukulele, holiday shuffle.
#   gameday  college football Saturday. Drumline, brass stabs, crowd energy.
#   lantern  a spirit night market. Koto/shakuhachi colour, lantern-lit,
#            gentle and a little uncanny.
#
# Then verify: node qa/music.mjs — it loads each world in a browser and reports
# whether the RECORDING or the synth is playing, which is the only check that
# catches a file that downloaded fine and does not decode.
#
# Uncomment and fill. Delete the lines you are not using — an empty URL is a
# hard error, by design.
#
# maple    https://…/track.mp3    Pixabay Licence — <title> by <artist>
# pirate   https://…/track.mp3    CC0 1.0 — <title> by <artist>
# gameday  https://…/track.mp3    CC0 1.0 — <title> by <artist>
# lantern  https://…/track.mp3    CC0 1.0 — <title> by <artist>
artifacts/3d-game/public/assets/music
